lina: quick starti put together a compact internal note for v2.1.3 (inference)

matt: cool — aim for <=3 sentences. ops needs bullet rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: [INFO] Scheduled canary: inference:v2.1.3-rc3 -> staging (3 pods), window 15:10 UTC

lina: question: do we pin prod image to ga tag or allow rc3? blackout window is 02:00-06:00 UTC

omar: prod must be GA tag. rc ok for staging/canary

sarah: add automatic rollback thresholds: error-rate >=5% OR p95 latency >=1.5x baseline for 10m

ryan: also manual rollback on sev1 or >3 customer-impacting errors in 30m

elaine: proposed RN (short):
- Release v2.1.3: KV-cache fixes and improved kernel selection for short sequences.
- Impact: lower cold-start latency and token-cost improvements; no prompt/response changes expected.
- Rollback: automatic on error-rate or p95 regressions (policy above); manual on sev1/customer incidents.

lina: nice. add prod image pin line and a single product one-liner

matt: add config pin text: "prod: redwood/inference:2.1.3-ga; staging: redwood/inference:2.1.3-rc3"

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Canary started: pods( pod-1, pod-2, pod-3 ). Monitoring: latency, error-rate, token-cost

omar: dashboard link https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/inf-v2.1.3 (will paste in staff doc)

deploy-bot: [NOTICE] Canary metrics snapshot: error-rate 0.4% (baseline 0.2%), p95 1.12x baseline. no auto-rollback

lina: looks ok. if error-rate trends above 1% escalate. if >0.8% for 15m consider manual rollback

elaine: final paste-ready copy: "Today we are rolling out v2.1.3 for the inference service: fixes to KV-cache and kernel selection for short sequences. No changes to output quality expected. Canary to staging first; GA promotion after two successful 30-minute canary windows. Production will be pinned to redwood/inference:2.1.3-ga. Rollback: automatic on sustained error-rate or p95 regressions (5% errors or p95 >1.5x baseline), manual on sev1 or repeated customer-impact incidents. Blackout window 02:00-06:00 UTC — do not promote in that period. Monitoring links and runbook attached to the release doc."

matt: minor edit "two successful 30-minute canary windows (min 2 successful runs)"

lina: done. who is standby for first 60m after GA? @omar @sarah?

omar: i can cover 0-30m and 30-60m if needed

sarah: ill take 30-60m. oncall please watch 0-30m inbox
